title: 'Usad pagong': Erwin Tulfo slams slow pace of Marawi rehabilitation
summary: Nearly 10,000 beneficiaries have yet to receive compensation for losses suffered during the Marawi siege, nine years after the urban conflict erupted in the southern Philippine city.
